head_and_shoulders.name: Head & Shoulders
head_and_shoulders.description: Bears break the critical neckline support after buyers exhaust at the central head peak.
head_and_shoulders.pro_tip: Measure the target from the Head peak to the Neckline, then project it downward from the breakdown.

inverse_head_and_shoulders.name: Inverse Head & Shoulders
inverse_head_and_shoulders.description: Buyers overcome neckline resistance following final seller capitulation at the inverse head trough.
inverse_head_and_shoulders.pro_tip: Waiting for a 4H/Daily close above the neckline and a valid retest offers the best Risk:Reward.

double_top.name: Double Top
double_top.description: Two failed attempts to break upper resistance trigger swift liquidation down to measured targets.
double_top.pro_tip: If Peak 2 has lower volume than Peak 1, the success probability can reach 80%.

double_bottom.name: Double Bottom
double_bottom.description: Sellers fail twice to print lower lows, creating strong floor support before an explosive rally.
double_bottom.pro_tip: A neckline breakout with a volume spike confirms valid institutional accumulation.

bull_flag.name: Bull Flag
bull_flag.description: High-momentum impulse pole followed by orderly consolidation channel before upward continuation.
bull_flag.pro_tip: Project a target equal to 100% of the flagpole height from the upper-channel breakout.

ascending_triangle.name: Ascending Triangle
ascending_triangle.description: Buyers continuously buy at higher lows while pressing against horizontal ceiling resistance.
ascending_triangle.pro_tip: Volatility compression near the triangle apex can produce a strong breakout squeeze.

bear_flag.name: Bear Flag
bear_flag.description: A sharp drop followed by a weak upward channel before continuation lower.
bear_flag.pro_tip: Wait for the lower boundary break; a flag can fail if price reclaims the pole aggressively.

bull_pennant.name: Bull Pennant
bull_pennant.description: A bullish impulse followed by a compact converging range before continuation.
bull_pennant.pro_tip: The shorter and tighter the compression, the cleaner the continuation context.

bear_pennant.name: Bear Pennant
bear_pennant.description: A bearish impulse followed by a compact converging range before continuation.
bear_pennant.pro_tip: A breakdown without volume or follow-through can return price into the pennant.

descending_triangle.name: Descending Triangle
descending_triangle.description: A flat support floor with lower highs pressing toward a bearish breakdown.
descending_triangle.pro_tip: Do not short the floor before a confirmed close below support.

falling_wedge.name: Falling Wedge
falling_wedge.description: Two converging downward boundaries that can resolve upward after confirmation.
falling_wedge.pro_tip: Use the upper-boundary close and structure context instead of anticipating the breakout.

rising_wedge.name: Rising Wedge
rising_wedge.description: Two converging upward boundaries that can resolve downward after confirmation.
rising_wedge.pro_tip: Use the lower-boundary close as confirmation instead of shorting too early.

triple_top.name: Triple Top
triple_top.description: Three resistance tests followed by a confirmed neckline breakdown.
triple_top.pro_tip: Three peaks are still a range until support breaks.

triple_bottom.name: Triple Bottom
triple_bottom.description: Three support tests followed by a confirmed neckline breakout.
triple_bottom.pro_tip: Wait for a body close above the intervening resistance.

cup_and_handle.name: Cup & Handle
cup_and_handle.description: A rounded base followed by a shallow pullback before a possible bullish breakout.
cup_and_handle.pro_tip: A deep handle invalidates the clean continuation interpretation.

inverse_cup_and_handle.name: Inverse Cup & Handle
inverse_cup_and_handle.description: A rounded top followed by a rising handle before a possible bearish breakdown below rim support.
inverse_cup_and_handle.pro_tip: Measure from the inverse cup peak to the rim, then project the distance lower after a breakdown and failed retest.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.description: A bullish reversal pattern appearing at the bottom of a downtrend with a long lower shadow and a small body near the high.
hammer.psychology: Sellers aggressively pushed prices to new lows, but strong institutional buying stepped in, rejecting lower prices and driving the close near the session high.
rules: Appears after a defined downtrend or pullback to key support.
Lower shadow must be at least 2x the height of the real body.
Little to no upper shadow.
Color of the body can be green (stronger) or red.
hammer.volume_rule: High or above-average volume on the hammer candle confirms institutional absorption.
hammer.entry_trigger: Buy on the break of the hammer candle high, or on a 50% wick retest.
hammer.stop_loss: 1-2 ticks below the lowest point of the lower shadow.
hammer.pro_tip: A green body hammer that forms right at a 200 EMA or daily support zone offers the highest probability setup.

shooting_star.name: Shooting Star
shooting_star.description: A bearish reversal pattern that forms after an uptrend, characterized by a long upper shadow and a small real body near the bottom.
shooting_star.psychology: Buyers drove price to new highs with optimism, but aggressive profit taking and institutional sellers absorbed the rally, closing near the open.
rules: Forms after a clear advance or at a major resistance ceiling.
Upper shadow must be at least 2x the height of the real body.
Little to no lower shadow.
Red body indicates stronger bearish dominance than green.
shooting_star.volume_rule: Volume spike at the top confirms exhaustion of retail buyers and institutional distribution.
shooting_star.entry_trigger: Sell / Short upon breaking below the shooting star low.
shooting_star.stop_loss: 1-2 ticks above the highest point of the upper shadow.
shooting_star.pro_tip: Look for shooting stars coinciding with RSI overbought (>70) or bearish divergence for high-confidence shorts.

inverted_hammer.name: Inverted Hammer
inverted_hammer.description: Bullish reversal pattern appearing at the bottom of a downtrend with a long upper wick, showing early buyer interest.
inverted_hammer.psychology: Bulls tested higher prices during the session. Although bears pushed it back down, bears were unable to make a new low, signaling shifting momentum.
rules: Appears at the end of a downtrend.
Upper wick is at least 2x the body length.
Small body near the session low.
Requires a strong bullish confirmation candle on the next session.
inverted_hammer.volume_rule: Higher volume signals accumulating interest from larger participants.
inverted_hammer.entry_trigger: Enter long only after the next candle closes ABOVE the Inverted Hammer high.
inverted_hammer.stop_loss: Below the low of the Inverted Hammer candle.
inverted_hammer.pro_tip: Never enter an inverted hammer without waiting for the next candle confirmation close.

doji.name: Doji
doji.description: A candle with nearly identical open and close prices that marks balance and uncertainty.
doji.psychology: Neither side controls the close. The next candle and the surrounding level decide whether indecision resolves into continuation or reversal.
rules: Open and close are equal or nearly equal.
Read the wick shape and the preceding trend.
Require a follow-through candle before acting.
doji.volume_rule: Volume expansion on the resolving candle is more useful than volume on the Doji itself.
doji.entry_trigger: Trade a confirmed break of the Doji high or low, not the Doji alone.
doji.stop_loss: Place invalidation beyond the opposite end of the Doji range.
doji.pro_tip: A Doji is context, not a standalone buy or sell signal.

bullish_engulfing.name: Bullish Engulfing
bullish_engulfing.description: A strong two-candle reversal pattern where a large green candle completely engulfs the entire body of the previous small red candle.
bullish_engulfing.psychology: Bears opened price lower, but bulls overwhelmed supply with explosive buying volume, engulfing the entire previous day range.
rules: Must occur after a clear downtrend or at major horizontal support.
First candle is bearish (red).
Second candle is bullish (green) and its body completely covers the previous body.
Second candle open is equal to or lower than the first candle close.
bullish_engulfing.volume_rule: Volume on the green engulfing candle should ideally exceed the volume of the preceding candle.
bullish_engulfing.entry_trigger: Enter long on the close of the engulfing candle or on the breakout of its high.
bullish_engulfing.stop_loss: Below the lowest low of the two-candle formation.
bullish_engulfing.pro_tip: When an engulfing candle wraps around 2 or 3 previous candles, the reversal conviction is exponentially higher.

bearish_engulfing.name: Bearish Engulfing
bearish_engulfing.description: A premier two-candle bearish reversal pattern where a large red candle engulfs the preceding green candle at the top of an uptrend.
bearish_engulfing.psychology: Buyers opened high with optimism, but aggressive institutional sellers hit the bids, driving price down and erasing days of gains in one session.
rules: Must occur after a defined uptrend or at major resistance/supply zone.
First candle is bullish (green).
Second candle is bearish (red) and completely engulfs the prior body.
Close of the red candle is well below the open of the prior green candle.
bearish_engulfing.volume_rule: High volume on the red candle confirms institutional dumping/distribution.
bearish_engulfing.entry_trigger: Short upon close of the bearish engulfing candle.
bearish_engulfing.stop_loss: Above the highest high of the engulfing pair.
bearish_engulfing.pro_tip: Look for bearish engulfing candles reacting off a multi-week resistance or overbought RSI for optimal risk-reward trades.

hanging_man.name: Hanging Man
hanging_man.description: A bearish warning candle with a small body near the high and a long lower shadow after an advance.
hanging_man.psychology: Sellers were able to push price sharply lower during the session, warning that the uptrend may be losing control.
rules: Appears after an advance or near resistance.
Lower shadow is at least about twice the body.
Wait for bearish confirmation on the next candle.
hanging_man.volume_rule: A rejection candle with elevated volume is more meaningful near a major resistance zone.
hanging_man.entry_trigger: Short only after a close below the Hanging Man low.
hanging_man.stop_loss: Above the candle high or the nearby swing high.
hanging_man.pro_tip: The same silhouette as a Hammer has a different meaning because location comes first.

dragonfly_doji.name: Dragonfly Doji
dragonfly_doji.description: A Doji with a long lower shadow and almost no upper shadow, showing rejection of lower prices.
dragonfly_doji.psychology: Sellers controlled the middle of the session, but buyers absorbed the decline and returned price to the open.
rules: Open and close are nearly equal.
The lower shadow dominates the range.
Interpret it with support and the preceding trend.
dragonfly_doji.volume_rule: Higher volume at support can confirm absorption, but does not guarantee reversal.
dragonfly_doji.entry_trigger: Buy after a close above the Dragonfly Doji high.
dragonfly_doji.pro_tip: At resistance it can simply mark exhaustion; location determines the bias.

gravestone_doji.name: Gravestone Doji
gravestone_doji.description: A Doji with a long upper shadow and almost no lower shadow, showing rejection of higher prices.
gravestone_doji.psychology: Buyers pushed higher but sellers absorbed the rally and forced the close back to the open.
rules: Open and close are nearly equal.
The upper shadow dominates the range.
Look for resistance or an extended uptrend.
gravestone_doji.volume_rule: A volume increase near resistance strengthens the rejection context.
gravestone_doji.entry_trigger: Short after a close below the Gravestone Doji low.
gravestone_doji.pro_tip: Do not short a Gravestone in isolation; wait for structure or candle confirmation.

spinning_top.name: Spinning Top
spinning_top.description: A small real body with upper and lower shadows that shows two-sided pressure and temporary balance.
spinning_top.psychology: Both sides moved price away from the open, but neither could hold control into the close.
rules: The body is small relative to the total range.
Both shadows are visible.
Use the next candle and structure for direction.
spinning_top.volume_rule: A high-volume Spinning Top near a key level deserves more attention than one in quiet chop.
spinning_top.entry_trigger: Trade the confirmed break of the range in the direction supported by context.
spinning_top.pro_tip: Treat it as a pause or warning, not an automatic reversal.

bullish_marubozu.name: Bullish Marubozu
bullish_marubozu.description: A long bullish candle with little or no wick that shows buyers controlled the session from open to close.
bullish_marubozu.psychology: Persistent demand absorbs available supply and leaves little room for sellers to retrace the candle.
rules: The body dominates the full range.
Open is near the low and close is near the high.
Confirm whether the candle breaks a meaningful level.
bullish_marubozu.volume_rule: Above-average volume supports the momentum reading.
bullish_marubozu.entry_trigger: Enter on a controlled close or a shallow retracement after confirmation.
bullish_marubozu.stop_loss: Below the candle midpoint or the structure it broke.
bullish_marubozu.pro_tip: A large Marubozu into resistance can be exhaustion rather than a clean continuation.

bearish_marubozu.name: Bearish Marubozu
bearish_marubozu.description: A long bearish candle with little or no wick that shows sellers controlled the session from open to close.
bearish_marubozu.psychology: Persistent supply overwhelms bids and leaves little room for buyers to recover the candle.
rules: The body dominates the full range.
Open is near the high and close is near the low.
Check whether the candle breaks support or arrives at exhaustion.
bearish_marubozu.volume_rule: Above-average volume supports the momentum reading.
bearish_marubozu.entry_trigger: Short on a confirmed support break or a controlled retest.
bearish_marubozu.stop_loss: Above the candle midpoint or the broken structure.
bearish_marubozu.pro_tip: A large candle into support can be capitulation, so context matters.

tweezer_bottom.name: Tweezer Bottom
tweezer_bottom.description: A two-candle bullish reversal with matching lows that shows repeated rejection at support.
tweezer_bottom.psychology: Sellers test the same price twice but cannot push below it, allowing buyers to defend the level.
rules: The lows are equal or nearly equal.
The second candle shows bullish response.
The pattern is stronger at established support.
tweezer_bottom.volume_rule: Volume on the rejection candle should be at least comparable to the first candle.
tweezer_bottom.entry_trigger: Enter above the second candle high after confirmation.
tweezer_bottom.pro_tip: Matching lows are useful only when the surrounding level has structural meaning.

tweezer_top.name: Tweezer Top
tweezer_top.description: A two-candle bearish reversal with matching highs that shows repeated rejection at resistance.
tweezer_top.psychology: Buyers test the same price twice but cannot push above it, allowing sellers to defend the level.
rules: The highs are equal or nearly equal.
The second candle shows bearish response.
The pattern is stronger at established resistance.
tweezer_top.volume_rule: Volume on the rejection candle should be at least comparable to the first candle.
tweezer_top.entry_trigger: Enter below the second candle low after confirmation.
tweezer_top.pro_tip: A Tweezer Top needs resistance context; equal highs in the middle of a range are not enough.

piercing_line.name: Piercing Line
piercing_line.description: A two-candle bullish reversal where the second candle closes above the midpoint of the prior bearish body.
piercing_line.psychology: Sellers extend the decline, but buyers recover more than half of the prior candle and reclaim momentum.
rules: It appears after a decline or at support.
The first candle is bearish.
The second bullish body closes above the first body midpoint.
piercing_line.volume_rule: Rising volume on the second candle supports the reversal attempt.
piercing_line.entry_trigger: Enter above the Piercing Line high or after a successful retest.
piercing_line.pro_tip: A shallow penetration of the first body is weaker and needs stronger confirmation.

dark_cloud_cover.name: Dark Cloud Cover
dark_cloud_cover.description: A two-candle bearish reversal where the second candle closes below the midpoint of the prior bullish body.
dark_cloud_cover.psychology: Buyers extend the advance, but sellers reclaim more than half of the prior candle and expose weakening demand.
rules: It appears after an advance or at resistance.
The first candle is bullish.
The second bearish body closes below the first body midpoint.
dark_cloud_cover.volume_rule: Rising volume on the second candle supports the rejection.
dark_cloud_cover.entry_trigger: Enter below the Dark Cloud Cover low or after a failed retest.
dark_cloud_cover.pro_tip: A close that barely enters the prior body is not enough by itself.

bullish_harami.name: Bullish Harami
bullish_harami.description: A two-candle setup where a small bullish body forms inside a prior large bearish body near support.
bullish_harami.psychology: Selling pressure contracts and the small second candle signals that bears are losing momentum.
rules: The second body stays inside the first body.
The pattern follows a decline or reaches support.
Use a bullish close for confirmation.
bullish_harami.volume_rule: Volume contraction in the small candle followed by expansion on confirmation is constructive.
bullish_harami.entry_trigger: Buy above the confirmation candle high.
bullish_harami.stop_loss: Below the large bearish candle low.
bullish_harami.pro_tip: The Harami is an alert to prepare, not permission to enter without confirmation.

bearish_harami.name: Bearish Harami
bearish_harami.description: A two-candle setup where a small bearish body forms inside a prior large bullish body near resistance.
bearish_harami.psychology: Buying pressure contracts and the small second candle signals that bulls are losing momentum.
rules: The second body stays inside the first body.
The pattern follows an advance or reaches resistance.
Use a bearish close for confirmation.
bearish_harami.volume_rule: Volume contraction in the small candle followed by expansion on confirmation is constructive.
bearish_harami.entry_trigger: Short below the confirmation candle low.
bearish_harami.stop_loss: Above the large bullish candle high.
bearish_harami.pro_tip: The Harami is an alert to prepare, not permission to enter without confirmation.

morning_star.name: Morning Star
morning_star.description: A three-candle bullish reversal with a strong bearish candle, a small star, and a strong bullish confirmation candle.
morning_star.psychology: The first candle continues the decline, the star shows hesitation, and the third candle proves buyers can reclaim momentum.
rules: The star is small relative to the first candle.
The third candle closes deep into the first body.
The setup is stronger near support.
morning_star.volume_rule: Volume often contracts on the star and expands on the confirmation candle.
morning_star.entry_trigger: Enter after the third candle closes above the first body midpoint.
morning_star.stop_loss: Below the star or formation low.
morning_star.pro_tip: A Morning Star is stronger when it also reclaims a broken level or moving average.

evening_star.name: Evening Star
evening_star.description: A three-candle bearish reversal with a strong bullish candle, a small star, and a strong bearish confirmation candle.
evening_star.psychology: The first candle continues the advance, the star shows hesitation, and the third candle proves sellers can reclaim momentum.
rules: The star is small relative to the first candle.
The third candle closes deep into the first body.
The setup is stronger near resistance.
evening_star.volume_rule: Volume often contracts on the star and expands on the confirmation candle.
evening_star.entry_trigger: Short after the third candle closes below the first body midpoint.
evening_star.stop_loss: Above the star or formation high.
evening_star.pro_tip: An Evening Star is stronger when it rejects a major resistance or liquidity pool.

three_white_soldiers.name: Three White Soldiers
three_white_soldiers.description: Three consecutive bullish candles with higher closes that show sustained buying pressure.
three_white_soldiers.psychology: Buyers hold control across several sessions and repeatedly accept higher prices.
rules: Three bullish bodies close progressively higher.
Each opens inside or near the previous body.
Wicks remain relatively small.
three_white_soldiers.volume_rule: Healthy expansion or sustained volume supports the continuation reading.
three_white_soldiers.entry_trigger: Enter on a controlled pullback after the third close.
three_white_soldiers.stop_loss: Below the first candle open or the latest swing low.
three_white_soldiers.pro_tip: Avoid chasing a third candle that is already far above its normal range.

three_black_crows.name: Three Black Crows
three_black_crows.description: Three consecutive bearish candles with lower closes that show sustained selling pressure.
three_black_crows.psychology: Sellers hold control across several sessions and repeatedly accept lower prices.
rules: Three bearish bodies close progressively lower.
Each opens inside or near the previous body.
Wicks remain relatively small.
three_black_crows.volume_rule: Healthy expansion or sustained volume supports the continuation reading.
three_black_crows.entry_trigger: Enter on a controlled pullback after the third close.
three_black_crows.stop_loss: Above the first candle open or the latest swing high.
three_black_crows.pro_tip: Avoid chasing a third candle that is already stretched into support.

rising_three_methods.name: Rising Three Methods
rising_three_methods.description: A bullish continuation sequence with a large bullish candle, a contained counter-trend pause, and a bullish resumption.
rising_three_methods.psychology: Profit taking stays contained inside the impulse range and fails to overcome the dominant demand.
rules: The small counter-trend candles stay inside the first candle range.
The final bullish candle closes beyond the first close.
The structure appears inside an uptrend.
rising_three_methods.volume_rule: Volume typically contracts during the pause and expands on resumption.
rising_three_methods.entry_trigger: Buy on the close above the first candle high.
rising_three_methods.pro_tip: The pattern is a continuation setup only while the impulse range remains protected.

falling_three_methods.name: Falling Three Methods
falling_three_methods.description: A bearish continuation sequence with a large bearish candle, a contained counter-trend pause, and a bearish resumption.
falling_three_methods.psychology: Profit taking stays contained inside the impulse range and fails to overcome the dominant supply.
rules: The small counter-trend candles stay inside the first candle range.
The final bearish candle closes beyond the first close.
The structure appears inside a downtrend.
falling_three_methods.volume_rule: Volume typically contracts during the pause and expands on resumption.
falling_three_methods.entry_trigger: Short on the close below the first candle low.
falling_three_methods.pro_tip: The pattern is a continuation setup only while the impulse range remains protected.

head_and_shoulders.name: Head & Shoulders
head_and_shoulders.description: The most reliable classical bearish reversal pattern, featuring a higher peak (head) between two lower peaks (shoulders) and a critical neckline support.
head_and_shoulders.psychology: Left shoulder forms as part of a normal uptrend. The head makes a new high, but with diminishing momentum. The right shoulder fails to make a higher high, signaling buyer exhaustion before neckline collapse.
structure_rules: Preceded by an extended, mature uptrend.
Head must be noticeably higher than both the Left and Right Shoulders.
Left and Right Shoulders should be relatively symmetrical in height and time.
Neckline connects the swing lows between the shoulders.
head_and_shoulders.neckline_rule: A decisive daily/4H candle close BELOW the neckline triggers the pattern activation.
head_and_shoulders.target_calculation: Target = Neckline Breakout Price - Vertical Height (Distance from Head Peak to Neckline).
head_and_shoulders.stop_loss_placement: Aggressive: Above the Right Shoulder high. Conservative: Just above the broken neckline (if retested).
head_and_shoulders.false_breakout_warning: Avoid shorting before the candle closes below the neckline; retail traders often get trapped by wick-only bounces.
head_and_shoulders.pro_tip: Right shoulders that take significantly longer to form than the left shoulder usually lead to deeper, faster selloffs.

inverse_head_and_shoulders.name: Inverse Head & Shoulders
inverse_head_and_shoulders.description: Premier bullish reversal pattern formed at the bottom of a downtrend with a central trough (head) lower than the two surrounding troughs (shoulders).
inverse_head_and_shoulders.psychology: Sellers make a final desperate attempt at the head, but fail to maintain downward momentum. The higher low on the right shoulder proves buyers have accumulated sufficient inventory to break resistance.
structure_rules: Appears after a protracted downtrend.
Head is the lowest point of the entire structure.
Right shoulder forms a higher low relative to the head.
Neckline acts as major resistance barrier.
inverse_head_and_shoulders.neckline_rule: Confirmed on candle close ABOVE the neckline resistance.
inverse_head_and_shoulders.target_calculation: Target = Breakout Price + Vertical Height (Distance from Head Lowest Low to Neckline).
inverse_head_and_shoulders.stop_loss_placement: Below the Right Shoulder low, or below the breakout candle low.
inverse_head_and_shoulders.false_breakout_warning: Wait for volume expansion on the neckline breakout to avoid getting trapped in sideways consolidation.
inverse_head_and_shoulders.pro_tip: Waiting for a retest of the broken neckline as new support improves win rate and tightens risk substantially.

double_top.name: Double Top ("M" Pattern)
double_top.description: Bearish reversal pattern consisting of two consecutive price peaks at nearly the same resistance level separated by a moderate trough.
double_top.psychology: Bulls push aggressively to the second peak but meet an overwhelming wall of institutional limit sell orders, failing to create a higher high.
structure_rules: Two peaks separated by at least 10-20 candles.
Peak 2 should not exceed Peak 1 by more than 1-2%.
The valley between peaks forms the baseline support (Neckline).
double_top.neckline_rule: Triggers when price closes below the central valley low.
double_top.target_calculation: Target = Neckline Price - Height of the Double Top.
double_top.stop_loss_placement: Above the highest peak, or above the midpoint of the right drop.
double_top.false_breakout_warning: Do not short at peak 2 prematurely before the neckline actually breaks.
double_top.pro_tip: If Peak 2 creates a bearish RSI divergence, the probability of a major collapse exceeds 80%.

double_bottom.name: Double Bottom ("W" Pattern)
double_bottom.description: Bullish reversal pattern resembling a "W", featuring two distinct swing lows at a shared support level followed by a breakout above the intermediate peak.
double_bottom.psychology: Bears attempt to break support a second time but find massive limit bids. The market rejects lower prices, creating a strong foundation for a trend reversal.
structure_rules: Two troughs formed at the same horizontal price zone.
Second trough often forms a slightly higher low or a liquidity sweep wick.
Central peak defines the breakout trigger level.
double_bottom.neckline_rule: Confirmed on a close above the intermediate swing high resistance.
double_bottom.target_calculation: Target = Breakout Price + Height from lowest trough to peak.
double_bottom.false_breakout_warning: Ensure the central peak is cleared with solid candle body close.
double_bottom.pro_tip: Look for the second bottom to form a bullish candlestick pattern like a Hammer or Engulfing for early low-risk positioning.

cup_and_handle.name: Cup & Handle
cup_and_handle.description: A powerful bullish continuation pattern shaped like a teacup: a rounded bottom consolidation (cup) followed by a shallow downward drift (handle).
cup_and_handle.psychology: The rounded cup represents steady institutional accumulation without panic. The handle represents mild, orderly profit-taking that shakes out weak hands before the explosive breakout.
structure_rules: Cup should have a smooth "U" shape, not a sharp "V".
Depth of the cup should typically be between 30% and 50% retracement of prior move.
Handle should retrace no more than 1/3 of the cup depth and slope downwards.
Breakout above the cup rim resistance confirms the trade.
cup_and_handle.neckline_rule: Entry triggers on candle close above the horizontal cup rim resistance line.
cup_and_handle.target_calculation: Target = Breakout Price + Vertical depth from cup rim to lowest point of the cup.
cup_and_handle.stop_loss_placement: Below the lowest point of the handle consolidation.
cup_and_handle.false_breakout_warning: Handles that drop deeper than 50% of the cup depth have a high probability of pattern failure.
cup_and_handle.pro_tip: Created by William O'Neil, this pattern is the cornerstone of leading growth stock and crypto mega-bull runs.

inverse_cup_and_handle.name: Inverse Cup & Handle
inverse_cup_and_handle.description: A bearish counterpart with a rounded top followed by a shallow upward handle before a possible breakdown below the rim.
inverse_cup_and_handle.psychology: A rounded top can reflect gradual distribution, while the rising handle allows a relief bounce before sellers test support again.
structure_rules: Forms after an extended advance or within a mature distribution area.
The inverse cup should curve gradually rather than form a sharp V rejection.
The handle rises shallowly and should not reclaim the full cup depth.
A breakdown below the rim or support should close with a solid body and volume confirmation.
inverse_cup_and_handle.neckline_rule: Consider bearish entry after a candle closes below rim support and the retest fails to reclaim the level.
inverse_cup_and_handle.target_calculation: Target = Breakdown Price - Vertical distance from the rim to the inverse cup peak.
inverse_cup_and_handle.stop_loss_placement: Above the handle high or the retest swing high.
inverse_cup_and_handle.false_breakout_warning: A wick below the rim that closes back inside the pattern is a failed breakdown, not bearish confirmation.
inverse_cup_and_handle.pro_tip: Inverse Cup & Handle is less common than Cup & Handle; prioritize structure, volume, and higher timeframe confirmation.

bull_flag.name: Bull Flag
bull_flag.description: A sharp bullish impulse followed by a tight downward-sloping consolidation channel.
bull_flag.psychology: Buyers pause to absorb profit taking while demand remains strong enough to protect most of the impulse.
structure_rules: A clear flagpole precedes the consolidation.
The flag slopes against the prior trend.
The retracement stays orderly and contained.
bull_flag.neckline_rule: Enter after a body close above the upper flag boundary.
bull_flag.target_calculation: Breakout price plus the approximate flagpole height.
bull_flag.stop_loss_placement: Below the latest flag swing low.
bull_flag.false_breakout_warning: A breakout without participation can fail back into the channel.
bull_flag.pro_tip: The best flags are tight, shallow, and supported by the prior impulse.

bear_flag.name: Bear Flag
bear_flag.description: A sharp, rapid downward sell-off (flagpole) followed by a sluggish, upward-sloping consolidation channel (flag) before downward continuation.
bear_flag.psychology: Heavy selling hits the market. The weak bounce lacks institutional participation and volume, forming a liquidity pool for institutional participants to load short positions before the next drop.
structure_rules: Preceded by a steep plunge on heavy volume.
Flag channel slopes upwards against the dominant downtrend.
Consolidation does not retrace more than 50% of the drop.
bear_flag.neckline_rule: Confirmed upon breaking below the lower trendline of the flag channel.
bear_flag.target_calculation: Target = Breakdown Price - Length of the initial Flagpole.
bear_flag.stop_loss_placement: Above the highest swing high of the flag consolidation.
bear_flag.false_breakout_warning: Ensure the flag does not break above 50% Fibonacci retracement of the pole.
bear_flag.pro_tip: Bear flags in a high-volatility market often reach their measured move target much faster than bull flags.

ascending_triangle.name: Ascending Triangle
ascending_triangle.description: A bullish pattern characterized by a horizontal upper resistance line and an ascending lower support trendline forming higher lows.
ascending_triangle.psychology: Sellers are stubborn at a fixed price ceiling, but buyers are increasingly aggressive, willing to buy at ever-higher prices until the resistance wall is completely depleted.
structure_rules: Flat horizontal resistance with at least 2 distinct touches.
Ascending trendline with at least 2 higher swing lows.
Price gets squeezed towards the apex before the breakout.
ascending_triangle.neckline_rule: Triggers on a candle close above the horizontal resistance ceiling.
ascending_triangle.target_calculation: Target = Breakout Price + Widest vertical height of the triangle base.
ascending_triangle.stop_loss_placement: Below the most recent swing low within the triangle.
ascending_triangle.false_breakout_warning: Wick-only penetrations above resistance without body close are common fakeout traps.
ascending_triangle.pro_tip: Breakouts that occur between 60% and 75% of the distance to the apex have the lowest failure rates.

descending_triangle.name: Descending Triangle
descending_triangle.description: A bearish pattern featuring a horizontal support floor and a descending upper trendline forming lower highs, applying increasing downward pressure.
descending_triangle.psychology: Buyers defend a fixed price floor, but each rally is weaker than the last (Lower Highs). Eventually, buyers are exhausted and the floor collapses.
structure_rules: Flat horizontal support tested multiple times.
Descending upper trendline showing selling pressure on rallies.
Pattern typically resolves with a downward breakdown.
descending_triangle.neckline_rule: Triggers on candle close below the horizontal support floor.
descending_triangle.target_calculation: Target = Breakdown Price - Widest vertical height of the triangle.
descending_triangle.stop_loss_placement: Above the most recent lower high.
descending_triangle.false_breakout_warning: Check overall macro trend to ensure this is not an exhaustion bottom spring.
descending_triangle.pro_tip: Beware of descending triangles at the bottom of long bear markets; they can occasionally act as powerful double/triple bottom reversal springboards.

falling_wedge.name: Falling Wedge
falling_wedge.description: A bullish pattern where price is bounded by two downward-sloping, converging trendlines, signaling losing bearish momentum.
falling_wedge.psychology: Prices are making lower lows and lower highs, but the slope of the lows is flattening faster than the highs. Bears are losing grip, paving the way for a sharp upside squeeze.
structure_rules: Both upper and lower trendlines must slope downward.
The trendlines must converge towards an apex.
Can act as a bullish reversal (in a downtrend) or bullish continuation (in an uptrend).
falling_wedge.neckline_rule: Triggers on breakout and close above the upper descending trendline.
falling_wedge.target_calculation: Target = Breakout point + Height of the widest part of the wedge base.
falling_wedge.stop_loss_placement: Below the lowest point of the wedge structure.
falling_wedge.false_breakout_warning: Wait for candle close above the upper trendline rather than entering during intraday wicks.
falling_wedge.pro_tip: Falling wedges accompanied by bullish RSI divergence have among the highest statistical edge in swing trading.

bull_pennant.name: Bull Pennant
bull_pennant.description: A bullish impulse followed by a compact converging triangle before continuation.
bull_pennant.psychology: Demand pauses in a smaller range without giving back the impulse, creating a compression zone.
structure_rules: A strong flagpole precedes the pennant.
The boundaries converge with lower highs and higher lows.
The consolidation remains relatively short.
bull_pennant.neckline_rule: Enter after a close above the upper pennant boundary.
bull_pennant.target_calculation: Breakout price plus the flagpole height.
bull_pennant.stop_loss_placement: Below the latest pennant swing low.
bull_pennant.false_breakout_warning: A deep retracement or weak breakout reduces the continuation case.
bull_pennant.pro_tip: Pennants are compression patterns; do not treat every small triangle as one.

bear_pennant.name: Bear Pennant
bear_pennant.description: A bearish impulse followed by a compact converging triangle before continuation.
bear_pennant.psychology: Supply pauses in a smaller range without allowing a meaningful recovery, creating downside compression.
structure_rules: A strong bearish flagpole precedes the pennant.
The boundaries converge with lower highs and higher lows.
The consolidation remains relatively short.
bear_pennant.neckline_rule: Enter after a close below the lower pennant boundary.
bear_pennant.target_calculation: Breakdown price minus the flagpole height.
bear_pennant.stop_loss_placement: Above the latest pennant swing high.
bear_pennant.false_breakout_warning: A breakout with no volume or immediate reclaim can be a trap.
bear_pennant.pro_tip: The pennant is valid only while the impulse context remains intact.

rising_wedge.name: Rising Wedge
rising_wedge.description: A bearish pattern formed by two converging upward-sloping boundaries with weakening range expansion.
rising_wedge.psychology: Price keeps making higher highs and higher lows, but the narrowing range shows that demand is losing follow-through.
structure_rules: Both boundaries slope upward.
The boundaries converge toward an apex.
It is stronger after an advance or near resistance.
rising_wedge.neckline_rule: Enter after a close below the lower wedge boundary.
rising_wedge.target_calculation: Breakdown price minus the widest part of the wedge.
rising_wedge.stop_loss_placement: Above the latest wedge swing high.
rising_wedge.false_breakout_warning: Do not anticipate the breakdown while price is still holding the lower boundary.
rising_wedge.pro_tip: A rising wedge is a structure warning, not a guarantee of immediate reversal.

triple_top.name: Triple Top
triple_top.description: A bearish reversal with three tests of a similar resistance level followed by a neckline break.
triple_top.psychology: Repeated tests fail to create a higher high, showing that supply absorbs each attempt to advance.
structure_rules: Three peaks form in the same resistance zone.
Valleys between peaks define the support area.
The pattern activates only after support breaks.
triple_top.neckline_rule: A volume increase on the breakdown adds confirmation.
triple_top.target_calculation: Short after a close below the shared support or neckline.
triple_top.false_breakout_warning: Three touches without a confirmed break are still a range, not a completed pattern.
triple_top.pro_tip: The third test is only useful if the market confirms rejection.

triple_bottom.name: Triple Bottom
triple_bottom.description: A bullish reversal with three tests of a similar support level followed by a neckline break.
triple_bottom.psychology: Repeated tests fail to create a lower low, showing that demand absorbs each selloff.
structure_rules: Three troughs form in the same support zone.
Peaks between troughs define the resistance area.
The pattern activates only after resistance breaks.
triple_bottom.neckline_rule: A volume increase on the breakout adds confirmation.
triple_bottom.target_calculation: Buy after a close above the shared resistance or neckline.
triple_bottom.false_breakout_warning: Three touches without a confirmed break are still a range, not a completed pattern.
triple_bottom.pro_tip: The third test is only useful if the market confirms demand.

rounding_top.name: Rounding Top
rounding_top.description: A gradual bearish reversal where an uptrend transitions through a broad, curved distribution range.
rounding_top.psychology: Momentum fades over time as each rally attracts less demand and sellers gradually take control.
structure_rules: The arc develops over a broad time window.
Price loses upward slope near the center of the formation.
Support break confirms completion.
rounding_top.neckline_rule: Distribution volume can increase near the support break.
rounding_top.target_calculation: Short after a close below the rounded base support.
rounding_top.stop_loss_placement: Above the latest swing high inside the right half.
rounding_top.false_breakout_warning: A shallow arc inside a range is not enough; require a confirmed support break.
rounding_top.pro_tip: Rounding structures need patience because the transition is gradual.

rounding_bottom.name: Rounding Bottom
rounding_bottom.description: A gradual bullish reversal where a downtrend transitions through a broad, curved accumulation range.
rounding_bottom.psychology: Selling pressure fades over time as price builds a base and demand gradually accepts higher prices.
structure_rules: The arc develops over a broad time window.
Price stops making meaningful lower lows near the center.
Resistance break confirms completion.
rounding_bottom.neckline_rule: Accumulation volume can increase near the resistance break.
rounding_bottom.target_calculation: Buy after a close above the rounded base resistance.
rounding_bottom.stop_loss_placement: Below the latest swing low inside the right half.
rounding_bottom.false_breakout_warning: A shallow arc inside a range is not enough; require a confirmed resistance break.
rounding_bottom.pro_tip: Rounding structures need patience because the transition is gradual.

ascending_channel.name: Ascending Channel
ascending_channel.description: A bullish continuation structure with price oscillating between two parallel rising boundaries.
ascending_channel.psychology: Both buyers and sellers accept progressively higher levels while the trend remains orderly.
structure_rules: The upper and lower boundaries rise in parallel.
Price reacts multiple times at both boundaries.
A break of the lower boundary weakens the trend.
ascending_channel.neckline_rule: Volume expansion on an upper-boundary break supports continuation.
ascending_channel.target_calculation: Buy near support after bullish confirmation or above a confirmed upper break.
ascending_channel.false_breakout_warning: A channel touch is not a breakout; wait for a body close.
ascending_channel.pro_tip: Channels work best when both boundaries have multiple clean reactions.

descending_channel.name: Descending Channel
descending_channel.description: A bearish continuation structure with price oscillating between two parallel falling boundaries.
descending_channel.psychology: Both sellers and buyers accept progressively lower levels while the trend remains orderly.
structure_rules: The upper and lower boundaries fall in parallel.
Price reacts multiple times at both boundaries.
A break of the upper boundary weakens the trend.
descending_channel.neckline_rule: Volume expansion on a lower-boundary break supports continuation.
descending_channel.target_calculation: Short near resistance after bearish confirmation or below a confirmed lower break.
descending_channel.false_breakout_warning: A channel touch is not a breakdown; wait for a body close.
descending_channel.pro_tip: Channels work best when both boundaries have multiple clean reactions.

symmetrical_triangle.name: Symmetrical Triangle
symmetrical_triangle.description: A bilateral compression pattern with lower highs and higher lows converging toward an apex.
symmetrical_triangle.psychology: Neither side has decisive control, so the range contracts until a confirmed breakout resolves the balance.
structure_rules: The upper boundary slopes down.
The lower boundary slopes up.
Wait for a body close outside the boundaries.
symmetrical_triangle.neckline_rule: Volume often contracts during compression and expands on the resolving break.
symmetrical_triangle.target_calculation: Trade the confirmed breakout direction with a defined invalidation.
symmetrical_triangle.stop_loss_placement: Beyond the opposite side of the triangle.
symmetrical_triangle.false_breakout_warning: Do not assume bullish direction simply because the range is tightening.
symmetrical_triangle.pro_tip: A symmetrical triangle is directional only after confirmation.

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.description: A horizontal consolidation range with repeated reactions between defined support and resistance.
rectangle.psychology: Buyers and sellers reach temporary balance while price builds liquidity at both edges of the range.
structure_rules: Support and resistance remain broadly horizontal.
Price reacts multiple times at both boundaries.
A body close outside the range confirms resolution.
rectangle.neckline_rule: A volume expansion on the break improves confirmation.
rectangle.target_calculation: Trade the confirmed break or a successful retest of the broken boundary.
rectangle.stop_loss_placement: Inside the range beyond the retest swing.
rectangle.false_breakout_warning: Wicks beyond the range that close back inside are failed breaks.
rectangle.pro_tip: The rectangle is a range until price proves otherwise.

moving_average_cross.title: EMA 20 / 50 / 200 for Golden Cross and Death Cross
moving_average_cross.summary: Use the EMA 20, 50, and 200 stack to read bullish or bearish regimes; Golden Cross and Death Cross provide context rather than standalone signals.
key_principles: EMA 20 represents short-term momentum; EMA 50 the intermediate trend; EMA 200 the long-term regime reference.
Golden Cross occurs when EMA 50 crosses above EMA 200; confirm it with price, EMA slope, and volume.
Death Cross occurs when EMA 50 crosses below EMA 200; confirm it with price structure and selling pressure.
Crossovers lag and can whipsaw in sideways markets; use higher timeframe context.
moving_average_cross.formula_or_setup: Bullish: Price > EMA 20 > EMA 50 > EMA 200. Bearish: Price < EMA 20 < EMA 50 < EMA 200. Read Golden Cross and Death Cross with structure and candle confirmation.
action_checklist: Define the regime from price position and the EMA 200 slope.
Confirm a Golden Cross or Death Cross after the closing candle, not while the lines are still crossing.
Wait for a pullback or retest of EMA 20/50 and assess whether the zone acts as support or resistance.
Place the Stop Loss beyond the latest swing and size the position for the distance at risk.
Use volume and higher timeframe context to filter whipsaw before entry or exit.
moving_average_cross.pro_tip: Golden Cross and Death Cross are lagging signals; in sideways markets, price structure and volume matter more than a single crossover.

rsi_divergence_mastery.title: RSI Divergence Regular Reversal and Hidden Continuation
rsi_divergence_mastery.summary: Detecting discrepancies between price action and momentum oscillator to anticipate impending reversals or powerful trend continuations.
key_principles: Regular Bullish Divergence: Price makes Lower Lows, but RSI makes Higher Lows (Signals major upside reversal).
Regular Bearish Divergence: Price makes Higher Highs, but RSI makes Lower Highs (Signals buyer exhaustion and downside reversal).
Hidden Bullish Divergence: Price makes Higher Lows, but RSI makes Lower Lows (Signals explosive trend continuation UP).
Hidden Bearish Divergence: Price makes Lower Highs, but RSI makes Higher Highs (Signals explosive trend continuation DOWN).
rsi_divergence_mastery.formula_or_setup: Divergence occurs when price slope and RSI oscillator slope disagree across at least 2 distinct swing points.
action_checklist: Identify two distinct price swings (Highs or Lows).
Check RSI values at the corresponding timestamps.
Wait for price action trigger: trendline break or candlestick confirmation.
Set invalidation Stop Loss just beyond the recent swing extreme.
rsi_divergence_mastery.pro_tip: Hidden divergence in the direction of the daily trend is one of the most profitable setups in technical analysis because you trade with institutional flow.

bollinger_squeeze_breakout.title: Bollinger Bands Squeeze & Volatility Expansion
bollinger_squeeze_breakout.summary: Trading the cyclical transition from low volatility contraction (The Squeeze) to explosive directional expansion.
key_principles: Markets oscillate between periods of low volatility (range contraction) and high volatility (range expansion).
The Squeeze: When upper and lower bands narrow to their tightest range in 20+ periods, a massive breakout is imminent.
Walking the Bands: In strong trends, price can hug the upper/lower band for extended periods.
%B Indicator: Measures relative price location between upper (1.0) and lower (0.0) bands.
bollinger_squeeze_breakout.formula_or_setup: Bandwidth = (Upper Band - Lower Band) / Middle Band. When Bandwidth hits a 6-month low, prepare for directional breakout.
action_checklist: Locate a prolonged Bollinger Squeeze where price is tightly coiling.
Check volume: low volume inside the squeeze is mandatory.
Wait for the first candle to close entirely OUTSIDE the upper (buy) or lower (sell) band with volume spike.
Enter on the breakout candle close.
Trailing Stop: Use the 20-period middle SMA line as your trailing exit.
bollinger_squeeze_breakout.pro_tip: Beware of the "Head Fake": a brief false breakout in one direction quickly followed by the real monster rally in the opposite direction.

smc_market_structure.title: Reading Structure and Trend Shifts
smc_market_structure.summary: Read the market like institutional algorithms: identify Break of Structure (BOS), Change of Character (CHoCH), Order Blocks, and Liquidity Pools.
key_principles: Structure: Uptrend = Higher Highs (HH) + Higher Lows (HL). Downtrend = Lower Highs (LH) + Lower Lows (LL).
BOS (Break of Structure): Price breaks and closes beyond the previous swing high/low in the direction of the dominant trend (Trend Continuation).
CHoCH (Change of Character): Price breaks the most recent swing low in an uptrend (or swing high in a downtrend), signaling the first early warning of a structural trend flip.
Order Block (OB): The last opposing candle before an aggressive impulse move that created a market imbalance/gap.
Liquidity Sweeps: Institutional flow pushes price past retail stop loss clusters (equal highs/lows) to fill large positions before reversing.
smc_market_structure.formula_or_setup: Trade Setup: 1) Identify HTF Trend & Liquidity Sweep -> 2) Wait for LTF CHoCH -> 3) Place Limit Order at the unmitigated Order Block / FVG.
action_checklist: Map the swing highs and swing lows on the 4-Hour / Daily timeframe.
Mark the key liquidity pools (Equal Highs, Equal Lows, Trendline Liquidity).
Wait for liquidity to be swept with a long wick rejection.
Drop to the 15-Minute or 5-Minute timeframe to witness a clean CHoCH (body close).
Enter on the retest of the freshly created Order Block / Fair Value Gap.
Stop Loss placed tightly behind the Order Block invalidation point (yielding 1:3 to 1:10 R:R).
smc_market_structure.pro_tip: Do not trade every Order Block you see on the chart. An Order Block is only valid if it caused a clear Break of Structure (BOS) and left a Fair Value Gap (FVG).

atr_dynamic_risk.title: ATR Dynamic Stop Loss & Volatility Risk Management
atr_dynamic_risk.summary: The exact mathematical risk framework used inside RabaLaba Terminal: adaptive stop loss sizing calibrated to real-time market volatility.
key_principles: Fixed percentage stops (e.g. always 2% or $1) fail because market volatility changes constantly across different market regimes.
Average True Range (ATR, 14-period) measures the true market noise and average candle expansion.
Optimal Stop Loss distance = 1.5x to 2.0x ATR below the entry or structural support, giving the trade room to breathe without getting stopped out by random market noise.
Position Sizing Formula: Position Size = (Account Capital * Risk %) / (Entry Price - Stop Loss Price).
atr_dynamic_risk.formula_or_setup: Stop Loss = Entry Price - (ATR × 1.5). Position Units = (Account $ × Risk %) / (ATR × 1.5).
action_checklist: Read the current 14-period ATR value on your trading timeframe.
Calculate Stop Loss buffer = Current Price - (1.5 * ATR) for long positions.
Determine max acceptable dollar risk (e.g. 1% of a $10,000 account = $100).
Divide max dollar risk by the stop loss dollar distance to calculate exact position size.
Never increase position size if market volatility spikes; reduce size to maintain constant risk.
atr_dynamic_risk.pro_tip: Professional traders do not focus on how much they can make; they focus exclusively on position sizing and managing downside risk.

multi_timeframe_framework.title: Top Down Multi Timeframe Analysis (HTF -> MTF -> LTF)
multi_timeframe_framework.summary: The 3-tier timeframe alignment process: use High Timeframe for bias, Medium Timeframe for key levels, and Low Timeframe for sniper entry execution.
key_principles: Rule of 4-6x: The higher timeframe should be 4x to 6x larger than the lower timeframe (e.g. Daily -> 4H -> 1H or 4H -> 1H -> 15m).
HTF (Daily/Weekly): Establishes the macro narrative, key support/resistance zones, and institutional bias.
MTF (4-Hour/1-Hour): Identifies the structure, swing highs/lows, and valid chart patterns.
LTF (15-Minute/5-Minute): Pinpoints precision entry triggers, candlestick confirmations, and minimizes stop-loss distance.
multi_timeframe_framework.formula_or_setup: HTF Trend: Bullish -> MTF Pullback to Support -> LTF Reversal Pattern (Hammer/Engulfing/CHoCH) = High-Probability Trade.
action_checklist: Step 1: Check Daily chart. Is price above EMA 200? Are we making Higher Highs?
Step 2: Check 4-Hour chart. Wait for price to pull back into a key Daily support level or EMA 50.
Step 3: Drop to 15-Minute chart. Look for a bullish candlestick pattern or break of structure.
Step 4: Execute on the 15-Minute candle close with Stop Loss below the local 15-Minute low.
Step 5: Target the Daily swing high for a massive 1:4+ Risk-to-Reward outcome.
multi_timeframe_framework.pro_tip: Never execute a trade on the lower timeframe that contradicts the dominant trend of the higher timeframe.

macd_momentum.title: MACD Momentum and Signal Cross
macd_momentum.summary: Use MACD line, signal line, and zero-line context to read momentum rather than treating every cross as an entry.
key_principles: The MACD line measures short-versus-long EMA momentum.
Crosses are stronger when aligned with the zero line.
Divergence can warn of weakening momentum but is not a timing trigger alone.
macd_momentum.formula_or_setup: Long bias: MACD crosses above signal while momentum is above or reclaiming zero. Short bias is the inverse.
action_checklist: Check whether price is at a meaningful level.
Place invalidation beyond the recent swing.
macd_momentum.pro_tip: MACD is derived from price and therefore lags; combine it with structure and risk control.

stochastic_oscillator.title: Stochastic Oscillator Context
stochastic_oscillator.summary: Use the K and D lines to compare the close with its recent range and identify momentum shifts.
key_principles: Overbought can persist in a strong uptrend.
Oversold can persist in a strong downtrend.
Crosses are more useful near a confirmed support or resistance zone.
stochastic_oscillator.formula_or_setup: Use a cross from an extreme zone only after price confirms the intended direction.
stochastic_oscillator.pro_tip: An oscillator is a filter for context, not a promise that price must reverse.

vwap_mean_reversion.title: VWAP Mean Reversion
vwap_mean_reversion.summary: Use session VWAP as a volume-weighted reference for intraday acceptance, rejection, and mean-reversion setups.
key_principles: Price above VWAP shows intraday acceptance, not guaranteed upside.
Repeated VWAP reclaims are stronger with volume.
Mean reversion works best in balanced sessions, not strong trends.
vwap_mean_reversion.formula_or_setup: Fade an extended move only after rejection and reclaim/loss of VWAP with a defined range.
action_checklist: Classify the session as trend or balance.
Exit at VWAP or the opposite liquidity area.
vwap_mean_reversion.pro_tip: Do not fade a strong trend simply because price is far from VWAP.

volume_profile.title: Volume Profile and Value Areas
volume_profile.summary: Read traded-volume concentration to locate point of control, value area, and low-volume rejection zones.
key_principles: High-volume nodes often behave as acceptance zones.
Low-volume areas can move quickly when revisited.
Profile levels need current price-action confirmation.
volume_profile.formula_or_setup: Use value-area high, value-area low, and point of control as levels; enter only after reaction or acceptance.
action_checklist: Choose the correct session or visible range.
volume_profile.pro_tip: Volume profile describes where activity occurred; it does not predict the next candle.

fibonacci_retracement.title: Fibonacci Retracement Confluence
fibonacci_retracement.summary: Use retracement ratios as a consistent way to frame pullback zones inside an established swing.
key_principles: Ratios are reference zones, not exact turning points.
Confluence with structure is more important than a single level.
The anchor swing must be clearly defined.
fibonacci_retracement.formula_or_setup: Map the impulse high and low, then wait for price reaction at a retracement zone plus structure.
action_checklist: Wait for candle or structure confirmation.
fibonacci_retracement.pro_tip: Fibonacci becomes useful when it organizes risk and context, not when it replaces analysis.

support_resistance_framework.title: Support and Resistance Framework
support_resistance_framework.summary: Build trade locations from repeated reaction zones instead of isolated horizontal lines.
key_principles: Zones are usually broader than one exact price.
Fresh reactions and failed breaks reveal participation.
A level changes role after a confirmed break and retest.
support_resistance_framework.formula_or_setup: Plan entries at a validated zone, then require rejection or acceptance before risking capital.
action_checklist: Grade freshness and number of reactions.
support_resistance_framework.pro_tip: The cleanest level is still a location; the trigger must come from price behavior.

smc_buy_side_liquidity.title: Buy Side Liquidity
smc_buy_side_liquidity.summary: Map resting buy stops above equal highs, obvious swing highs, and range extremes as a liquidity reference.
key_principles: Liquidity is an area of potential orders, not a guaranteed target.
Equal highs are more visible and therefore easier to cluster.
A sweep and close back inside is different from acceptance above.
smc_buy_side_liquidity.formula_or_setup: Mark the pool above a clear high, then wait to see whether price sweeps and rejects or accepts above it.
action_checklist: Mark equal highs and range extremes.
smc_buy_side_liquidity.pro_tip: Do not label every wick above a high as manipulation.

smc_sell_side_liquidity.title: Sell Side Liquidity
smc_sell_side_liquidity.summary: Map resting sell stops below equal lows, obvious swing lows, and range extremes as a liquidity reference.
key_principles: Liquidity is an area of potential orders, not a guaranteed target.
Equal lows are more visible and therefore easier to cluster.
A sweep and close back inside is different from acceptance below.
smc_sell_side_liquidity.formula_or_setup: Mark the pool below a clear low, then wait to see whether price sweeps and rejects or accepts below it.
action_checklist: Mark equal lows and range extremes.
smc_sell_side_liquidity.pro_tip: Do not label every wick below a low as manipulation.

smc_bullish_order_block.title: Bullish Order Block
smc_bullish_order_block.summary: Study the final bearish candle or base before a validated bullish displacement and structure break.
key_principles: The zone is a hypothesis until the impulse proves it mattered.
A fresh zone is generally easier to invalidate cleanly.
Location and higher-timeframe bias still matter.
smc_bullish_order_block.formula_or_setup: Wait for bullish displacement and BOS, then consider a retest of the unmitigated demand zone.
smc_bullish_order_block.pro_tip: An order block without displacement or structure confirmation is only a candle.

smc_bearish_order_block.title: Bearish Order Block
smc_bearish_order_block.summary: Study the final bullish candle or base before a validated bearish displacement and structure break.
key_principles: The zone is a hypothesis until the impulse proves it mattered.
A fresh zone is generally easier to invalidate cleanly.
Location and higher-timeframe bias still matter.
smc_bearish_order_block.formula_or_setup: Wait for bearish displacement and BOS, then consider a retest of the unmitigated supply zone.
smc_bearish_order_block.pro_tip: An order block without displacement or structure confirmation is only a candle.

smc_bullish_fvg.title: Bullish Fair Value Gap
smc_bullish_fvg.summary: Use a three-candle imbalance where the third candle leaves an untraded range above the first candle high.
key_principles: An FVG marks fast price delivery, not guaranteed support.
The gap can fill partially or completely.
Trend and displacement quality matter.
smc_bullish_fvg.formula_or_setup: Wait for bullish displacement, mark the imbalance, and evaluate a retest with structure confirmation.
smc_bullish_fvg.pro_tip: Not every three-candle gap is a tradable FVG; context filters noise.

smc_bearish_fvg.title: Bearish Fair Value Gap
smc_bearish_fvg.summary: Use a three-candle imbalance where the third candle leaves an untraded range below the first candle low.
key_principles: An FVG marks fast price delivery, not guaranteed resistance.
The gap can fill partially or completely.
Trend and displacement quality matter.
smc_bearish_fvg.formula_or_setup: Wait for bearish displacement, mark the imbalance, and evaluate a retest with structure confirmation.
smc_bearish_fvg.pro_tip: Not every three-candle gap is a tradable FVG; context filters noise.

smc_premium_zone.title: Premium Zone
smc_premium_zone.summary: Frame the upper half of a defined dealing range as an area where long entries need extra selectivity.
key_principles: Premium and discount require a clear range high and low.
A zone is not a signal by itself.
Use it with structure and liquidity context.
smc_premium_zone.formula_or_setup: For bearish ideas, look for rejection or short-side confirmation in the premium half of the range.
action_checklist: Wait for rejection or structure shift.
smc_premium_zone.pro_tip: Premium is a location label, not proof that price must fall.

smc_discount_zone.title: Discount Zone
smc_discount_zone.summary: Frame the lower half of a defined dealing range as an area where long entries can be evaluated selectively.
key_principles: Premium and discount require a clear range high and low.
A zone is not a signal by itself.
Use it with structure and liquidity context.
smc_discount_zone.formula_or_setup: For bullish ideas, look for rejection or long-side confirmation in the discount half of the range.
action_checklist: Wait for rejection or structure shift.
smc_discount_zone.pro_tip: Discount is a location label, not proof that price must rise.

smc_bullish_breaker.title: Bullish Breaker Block
smc_bullish_breaker.summary: Track a failed bearish order block that flips into potential support after bullish structure confirmation.
key_principles: A breaker is a failed zone that changes role.
The failure must be visible in structure, not just a wick.
Retests need context and invalidation.
smc_bullish_breaker.formula_or_setup: Wait for a bearish zone to fail, bullish BOS to confirm, then evaluate the retest as support.
smc_bullish_breaker.pro_tip: A breaker is not simply any candle that price crosses.

smc_bearish_breaker.title: Bearish Breaker Block
smc_bearish_breaker.summary: Track a failed bullish order block that flips into potential resistance after bearish structure confirmation.
key_principles: A breaker is a failed zone that changes role.
The failure must be visible in structure, not just a wick.
Retests need context and invalidation.
smc_bearish_breaker.formula_or_setup: Wait for a bullish zone to fail, bearish BOS to confirm, then evaluate the retest as resistance.
smc_bearish_breaker.pro_tip: A breaker is not simply any candle that price crosses.

smc_liquidity_sweep.title: Liquidity Sweep
smc_liquidity_sweep.summary: Study a brief breach of an obvious high or low followed by rejection and a confirmed structure response.
key_principles: A sweep needs a visible liquidity reference.
The close back inside matters more than the wick alone.
Structure confirmation reduces premature entries.
smc_liquidity_sweep.formula_or_setup: Map the pool, wait for the breach and rejection, then use CHoCH or BOS as the confirmation trigger.
smc_liquidity_sweep.pro_tip: A sweep is a scenario to test, not evidence of a guaranteed institutional trap.

smc_displacement.title: Displacement
smc_displacement.summary: Identify an unusually strong directional move that breaks structure and leaves inefficient price delivery behind.
key_principles: Displacement is relative to recent volatility.
A large candle without structure impact is less meaningful.
Follow-through and retest quality matter.
smc_displacement.formula_or_setup: Use displacement to confirm intent, then evaluate the retest of the resulting zone or imbalance.
action_checklist: Compare candle range with recent bars.
smc_displacement.pro_tip: Displacement is confirmation of urgency, not a reason to chase an extended candle.

quiz_1.title: Candlestick Identification at Major Support
quiz_1.question: Price drops 8 sessions in a row into historical support. A small real body forms at top with lower shadow 3x body height and surging volume. What is the pattern and optimal action?

q1_a.text: Shooting Star. Open aggressive short position immediately.
q1_a.explanation: Incorrect. Shooting stars form at tops with upper shadow, not at support with long lower wick.

q1_b.text: Bullish Hammer. Open Long above the high with Stop Loss below the low.
q1_b.explanation: Correct! Small body at top with long lower wick signals selling absorption at support.

q1_c.text: Bearish Marubozu. Prepare for deeper downtrend continuation.
q1_c.explanation: Incorrect. Marubozu has full solid body with virtually no wicks.

q1_d.text: Gravestone Doji. Close all positions and hold cash.
q1_d.explanation: Incorrect. Gravestone Doji features a long upper wick, whereas this candle has lower wick.

quiz_1.pro_tip: Hammer candles with heavy volume at support hold historical win rates above 68%.

quiz_2.title: Chart Pattern Neckline Breakout Confirmation
quiz_2.question: Daily chart forms left peak at $100, middle peak at $115, and right peak at $101. Neckline connects troughs at $88. Candle closes at $85 on heavy volume. What is the pattern and target?

q2_a.text: Triple Top with projected downside target at $75.
q2_a.explanation: Incorrect. Middle peak is significantly higher than both outer peaks.

q2_b.text: Head and Shoulders with measured move target at $61.
q2_b.explanation: Correct! Measured move equals neckline breakdown $88 minus head height $27 to reach $61.

q2_c.text: Cup and Handle with upside target at $130.
q2_c.explanation: Incorrect. Cup and Handle is a bullish continuation, not a bearish topping pattern.

q2_d.text: Double Top with downside target at $80.
q2_d.explanation: Incorrect. Double Top only features two peaks of equal height.

quiz_2.pro_tip: Neckline retest at $88 provides optimal short entry with minimal risk exposure.

quiz_3.title: RSI Momentum and Divergence Detection
quiz_3.question: Bitcoin 1D chart prints new high at $98,000 above prior $92,000 peak. However RSI prints 64 versus prior peak reading of 79. What signal is shown on chart?

q3_a.text: Bullish Continuation because buying momentum is accelerating.
q3_a.explanation: Incorrect. Price Higher High with RSI Lower High indicates decelerating momentum.

q3_b.text: Regular Bearish Divergence signaling buyer exhaustion and potential sharp correction.
q3_b.explanation: Correct! Higher high in price with lower high in RSI is textbook Regular Bearish Divergence.

q3_c.text: Hidden Bullish Divergence projecting straight rally to $120,000.
q3_c.explanation: Incorrect. Hidden Bullish requires price Higher Low and RSI Lower Low.

q3_d.text: Neutral market condition with no technical indication.
